en.text:
Increases <stasis/>Duskfield Grenade radius by 25% and spawns a Medium <stasis/>Stasis Crystal in its center.

Enemies inside a <stasis/>Duskfield Grenade's Slowing Field deal <pve 50% /> <pvp [20%] /> decreased damage.

You and allies immediately receive 1 Stack of <stasis/>Frost Armor upon entering the <stasis/>Slowing Field and receive additional Stacks for every 0.5 seconds they stay in the field.

When combined with the <stasis/>Touch of Winter aspect:
• Increases <stasis/>Crystal size from Medium to Large
• Radius increase stacks additively for a total of 75%
